pageHeadHtml:
Disclosures

Research funding and professional relationships relevant to my clinical AI work. This page distinguishes programme roles from paid clinical work and is reviewed when those relationships change.
pageBodyHtml:
Research funding

I am Principal Investigator on competitively funded clinical AI programmes and supervise clinical or technical teams on two Gates Foundation-supported programmes led by Prof. Anurag Agrawal. Roles, public award records and amounts are listed on Grants & Funding.

Research and programme relationships

  • Qure.ai — clinical validation and product-feedback work.
  • Manentia AI — clinical AI collaborator and PREDICT-AI consortium partner.
  • Radiogram — clinical workflow and structured-reporting collaboration.
  • Tata Memorial Hospital — PREDICT-AI research partner.
  • Microsoft Research India — clinical AI evaluation and ambient-AI research collaboration.
  • Google and OpenAI — research-support programmes for CRASH Lab.

Clinical work

Locum radiologist at Medanta and Fortis Hospitals, December 2024–January 2025.

Equity and honoraria

No equity interests are declared. No honoraria are declared beyond standard conference or institutional speaker arrangements associated with appearances on the Talks page.

For questions or corrections, contact suvrankar.datta@ashoka.edu.in.
